entities.summary: Ervin Bauer was a Hungarian biologist. He developed the first detailed concept of theoretical biology from the standpoint of biophysics and bioenergetics. He is also known for his work in pathology. A communist, Bauer emigrated to the Soviet Union in 1925 and was murdered in the Great Purge in 1938.
